2115929196467982576.en_summary: $AMZN says Leo “remains on track to begin initial service” by year-end as Amazon prepares to enter satellite broadband market. ticker_notes.AMZN: 履約網絡已有超過百萬機器人，正自動化最後配送環節以降低人工成本
